title: Black Book: Untold Legends
description: Read the Black Book Untold Legends in Benkongerike Great Hall and navigate through Hermaeus Mora's realm of Apocrypha to learn its hidden knowledge and choose one of three rewards: Bardic Knowledge, Black Market, or Secret Servant.

base_facts: The Black Book Untold Legends is found in Benkongerike Great Hall.
Reading it transports the reader to Hermaeus Mora's realm of Apocrypha.
It grants one of three lesser powers: Bardic Knowledge, Black Market, or Secret Servant.

ENTERED_APOCRYPHA: The reader has been transported to Apocrypha and must uncover the hidden knowledge.
COMPLETED_QUEST: The hidden knowledge of Untold Legends has been claimed and one of three lesser powers selected as a reward: Bardic Knowledge, Black Market, or Secret Servant.
The reward choice can be changed at any time by returning to Solstheim and re-reading the book, which transports the reader back to Apocrypha near the reward selection.
Completing this Black Book quest contributes to the Hidden Knowledge achievement.

base_facts: A Dremora merchant can be summoned using the Black Market power to trade items for 15 seconds.

COMPLETED_QUEST: If the Black Market power was chosen, the Dremora merchant can now be summoned to trade with the player for 15 seconds per use.
The Dremora merchant remains available as long as the Black Market power is active; swapping to a different reward via re-reading the book removes access.

base_facts: A Dremora butler can be summoned using the Secret Servant power to carry up to 148 weight in items for 15 seconds.

COMPLETED_QUEST: If the Secret Servant power was chosen, the Dremora butler can now be summoned to carry up to 148 weight in items for 15 seconds per use.
The Dremora butler remains available as long as the Secret Servant power is active; swapping to a different reward via re-reading the book removes access.

beats.comment: Player read the Black Book and entered Apocrypha.
Player is exploring through the chapters of Apocrypha, battling lurkers and seekers.
Player reached the end and is choosing between the three reward powers.
Player learned the hidden knowledge and chose a reward. Quest is complete.
